prompt_en: An ancient Cham tower standing on a hill in the afternoon sun.
refined_prompt: An ancient Cham tower standing on a hill in the afternoon sun. An ancient Cham tower rises majestically on a hill, its intricate stone carvings catching the golden afternoon sun. The texture of the weathered stone feels rough under the touch of the wind, while the scent of the fresh rice paddies fills the air. Lush greenery and rolling rice fields surround the tower, creating a serene and picturesque setting. This tower, a symbol of the rich Cham heritage, stands tall in Phan Rang–Tháp Chàm, a city in Vietnam known for its historical significance and cultural importance. Similar to the Taj Mahal in India, the Cham tower holds a revered place in the community, reflecting the deep spiritual and historical roots of the region.
